paragraphs.text: Good afternoon sisters and elders. I hope your day is going well and you're making productive choices. There are no new updates to discuss but we did have our MLC today and we did it through Zoom conference call technology. I think it turned out really really well. Now it's always gonna be better to meet in person but I believe that we accomplished all the Lord wanted us to accomplish. Plus by doing our MLC today this way we were able to try out the technology and this is what we're gonna be using doing our district conferences next week. And I'm confident we can have really really super powerful uplifting inspiring conferences based on what we experienced today. So that's the good news.
Alright power scrub. Hope it's going well for you. Your apartments are so clean that you just love being in them. You know what they say? Cleanliness is next to godliness.

Alright as I mentioned yesterday today I want to share some ideas with you about step two in the five-step process on how to achieve big and important goals. These big and important goals are the best way I've found to keep your mind and heart and your actions on the right path towards your worthy mortal goals and your hope of eternal life. When we have something that is very important to us and it's clearly defined then we have less problems being distracted by the worldly temptations that are that are really all around us.

So here's step two. It is to identify and never tolerate the problems that stand in the way of achieving your goals. Now it seems obvious to do this but interestingly enough human beings don't like identifying problems if those problems make them look bad or weak or make them make hard decisions about other people that they care about. But you're never going to get anywhere really important if you don't make this an absolute rule in your life that you will simply identify and never tolerate the problems that stand in the way of you achieving your goals.

Alright now this step has six basics that we need to consider. First you must view painful problems as potential improvements that are simply trying to introduce themselves to you. Though it won't feel like that at first even rather each and every problem you encounter is an opportunity for you to get more knowledge and more skill. For that reason it's essential that you bring these things to the surface. Most people don't like to do this especially as I said if it exposes their own weaknesses or the weaknesses of someone they care about. But successful people know they have to do it. You simply can't get where you're going unless you get more knowledge more skill and gather around you people who also have the necessary knowledge and skill to do what they need to do. To believe that you can get some place without having the knowledge and the skill without being partnered with people with the knowledge and the skill is simply a delusion and so you have to do it.

Secondly don't avoid confronting problems because they're rooted in harsh realities that are very unpleasant to look at. Life is tough sometimes. Reality can be brutal sometimes. I mean thinking about problems that are really difficult to solve may make you anxious but not thinking about them and hence not dealing with them should make you more anxious and ultimately if you don't deal with them you will have more anxiety and more stress and more worries and more problems because the problem will never be smaller than it is right now as far as solving it. So if you confront it and deal with it right now no matter how unpleasant it is or no matter how unpleasant the reality is then at least you're getting it smaller than it's going to be when it grows bigger.

When a problem stems from your own lack of talent or your own lack of skill most people feel shame. Get over it. I mean everybody's got weaknesses and nobody's as good as they want to be. In fact the whole notion of achieving big goals automatically means that you don't have the skill and the knowledge right now to to get that goal. If you did if you you know if you've done this thing a thousand times why are you setting a goal for it right? The only reason you set a goal for it would be because it's something new and bigger than you've currently ever done before. So just I can't emphasize this enough. Acknowledging your weaknesses is not the same as surrendering to them. The fact that you have identified it the fact you've acknowledged I've got a weakness in this area I don't have enough knowledge here or enough skill there or some other you know problem the fact you acknowledged it doesn't make it bigger it's the first step in overcoming it. So let's be honest the pains you're feeling are growing pains. Sure they'll test your character but they'll reward you as you push through them.

Third be specific in identifying your problems you need to be precise remember we talk about this precision is such an important attribute there are so many people that are just so vague they're so general they're so all over the place that they don't even know what they're doing let alone you being able to know what they're doing. So be precise different problems have different solutions. If a problem is due to inadequate skill maybe you need to get some more training or some more practice. If it arises from a personal weakness you may need to seek some assistance from somebody get some coaching maybe you need to talk to somebody who's already done what you wanted to want to do so that you can understand how to overcome that weakness in yourself. I mean it's like this if you're bad at accounting hire an accountant if the if the problem stems from somebody else's weaknesses that you're partnered with replace them with someone who's strong where it's needed. Here again it's harsh but reality is what it is and you can't just say well I'm just going to take the easy way out because the easy way out leads to a dead end and that's all there is to it.

Fourth don't mistake a cause of a problem with the real problem. I can't get enough sleep that's not a problem it's potentially a cause or the result of a problem so to clarify your thinking try to identify a bad outcome first for example I'm really not performing very well in my mission now maybe not sleeping enough maybe the cause of that problem maybe you're not getting to bed early enough or you're you're not getting a deep enough sleep while you're sleeping or the cause maybe something else but in order to determine what the cause is you first need to know exactly what the problem is I hope you get that so distinguish between problems and their causes the first thing you have to do is figure out what the problem is with precision and then you can back out of that and find out what the cause is and there may be several causes but there will be one primary cause.

Fifth distinguish between big problems and little problems you only have so much time and energy so make sure you're investing your time and energy in exploring the problems that if you fix them would really yield you the biggest returns but at the same time make sure you spend enough time on the small problems to make sure that they don't become big problems or that they're not just symptoms of a bigger problem that you haven't discovered yet.

Finally six once you identify a problem you must not tolerate it simply don't put up with it and don't put it off to another day tolerating a problem has the same consequences as just not even identifying it so whether you tolerate it because you believe it can't be solved or because you don't care enough to solve it or because you can't muster enough of whatever grip that it takes to solve it if you don't have the will to succeed then your situation is hopeless you need to develop a fierce i mean fierce intolerance of badness of any kind regardless of what kind it is simply be unwilling to accept in yourself and those you partner with any kind of bad behavior bad actions bad thinking by tolerating that you simply are pouring water on it and it's going to grow so be willing once you've identified the problem to go to work on it if it's about you deal with it if it's about someone else deal with it but do not just let it slide letting something slide is basically cowardice and coward's never accomplish anything worthwhile in this world so basically deal with it and face it and the moment you do you'll realize it wasn't the scary thing you thought it was and pretty soon you get yourself in a position to just climb over every wall that you come to because you say I've done this before I can do it again it's kind of a cool place to get to by the way.

Now I know that some of you probably right now are saying wow that sounds like that's painful hard i don't think I want to do that I think I'll just kind of live the life i have and not set such big goals well before you make that tragic mistake let me share a poem with you that someone shared with me when i was about your age it's called my wage and it was written by a woman by the name of Jessie B. Rittenhouse goes like this

I bargained with Life for a penny,
And Life would pay no more,
However I begged at evening
When I counted my scanty store;
For Life is a just employer,
He gives you what you ask,
But once you have set the wages,
Why, you must bear the task.
I worked for a menial's hire,
Only to learn, dismayed,
That any wage I had asked of Life,
Life would have willingly paid.

More than anything else elders and sisters i want you to understand the power of the gift god has given us of agency he sacrificed his only be gotten son and his son willingly sacrificed his mortal life and endured incomprehensible pain and suffering just so that we could have agency please don't waste your agency on weak choices or short-term choices this is your life and it will define who you are and where you are in the eternities choose the right way it will usually be the hard way the uphill way if you do you will be pleased with who you are and how your life turns out remember what my good friend Jerzy Gregorek says hard choices easy life easy choices hard life so elders and sisters make your life both mortal and eternal easy by making hard choices now face your weaknesses and inadequacies boldly and then make the necessary adjustments to become stronger smarter and better have a great rest of the day and be sure to get those apartments really clean the Crosses and Stoddard's and nelson's are looking forward to these inspections i love you elders and sisters continue to be so proud of you and your good choices talk to you tomorrow
